user: I'm CUS-0004. Transaction TX-0401, 240.00 EUR: the goods never arrived. Which reason code applies?
answer:
What I checked
- I reviewed your account (ACC-1005) and the transaction TX-0401 (TechMart Online, settled 2026-07-20, €240.00).
- I checked Verta's dispute reason-code definitions.

What applies
- The correct reason code for "goods never arrived" is goods_not_received.
- The goods_not_received code has a 90-day dispute window.

What that means for TX-0401
- TX-0401 settled on 2026-07-20. Today is 2026-10-28, which is 100 days after the transaction — outside the 90-day window — so a dispute under goods_not_received would be ineligible.

Next steps I can take for you
- If you want, I can run a formal eligibility check (check_dispute_eligibility) to confirm and, if eligible, open the dispute on your behalf.
- If the dispute is ineligible and you’d like help pursuing the merchant directly, I can prepare and send a statement for this account to the email on file, or escalate to a human agent to assist further. Tell me which you prefer.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
